# Version 4.159.0
> **Faster browser raster rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.159.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 Preview 1 brings Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. The native update also includes image and rendering correctness fixes. WebAssembly consumers now require .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Upgrade WebAssembly consumers to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp retire .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets and reject unsupported WASM frameworks before building. Retarget browser applications to .NET 9 or later: .NET 9/10 uses Emscripten 3.1.56 archives and .NET 11+ uses 6.0.2. Newer archives are not interchangeable with older toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia m159** — Adds WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering correctness fixes without changing C API exports or public managed signatures. HarfBuzzSharp's 15.0.0.100 milestone revision continues to bundle HarfBuzz 15.0.0. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and the same public API. Its WebAssembly assets now require .NET 9 or later, selecting runtime-matched archives for .NET 9/10 and .NET 11+; non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.

## Preview 1 (November 14, 2026)

Introduces Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. Browser native assets require .NET 9 or later, while HarfBuzzSharp's 15.0.0.100 revision retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17...v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)
